empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.note: Your linked mailboxes will appear in this list.

hero.title: Bring encrypted mail to the app you already use
hero.subtitle: Bridge runs locally, decrypting your Internxt mailbox for Apple Mail, Outlook or Thunderbird. Sign in once in your browser and you land right back here.

local.title: Keys stay local
local.note: Decryption happens on this device only.

background.title: Runs in background
background.note: Syncs quietly from the menu bar.

connect.title: Connect a mail client
connect.note: Pick your app and Bridge writes the account for you — or copy the keys below by hand.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.note: Bridge can follow macOS or stay on a fixed theme.

login.title: Launch Bridge at login
login.note: Start syncing before you open your mail client.

menubar.title: Keep running in the menu bar
menubar.note: Closing the window leaves Bridge active.

updates.title: Install updates automatically
updates.note: Apply new versions on the next restart.

ports.title: Local ports
ports.note: Change these only if another app already uses them.
